scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Unmarried
other_conditions: Must be a domicile of Haryana or have resided in the state for at least the last 15 years
Must possess a Family ID verified by Haryana Parivar Pehchan Authority (HPPA)
Must not have more than one bank account under PFMS; multiple accounts will be terminated and result in ineligibility
Change of address must be reported; shifting outside Haryana for more than three months makes one ordinarily ineligible, except hardship cases up to one year
If the beneficiary gets married after receiving the benefit, the amount will be recovered with 12% interest per annum
Benefits cease upon death of the beneficiary, but a full month’s payment is made to the nominee
Financial assistance is not attachable by any court of law
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2750 payable until the beneficiary turns 60 years old.
